stand_in.structure: the owners of one building pay a level annual fee for the EPC term; the fee repays RenESCO's financed share of the building's cost at the fee rate (level annuity)

cost_per_building.source: renesco_labeef_latvia numbers.derived.capex_per_block_avg: CITY20 p.5 'una inversión de 4 M EUR' for '15 edificios' (an average, not a printed block cost)

term_years.source: renesco_labeef_latvia numbers: EUT L1782 'a 20 year contract'; A61 L4239 '(20 years)' (sourced)
